title: Seventh Coin Collection Suppresses Score Award
explanation: At frame 469, Coin7 (Coin8 in scene) was collected triggering coin_picked with score 100, but coin_score_awarded logged score_before: 490 and score_after: 490. Traced to Coin.gd:L58-L63 (picked) where total_coins_collected == 7 forcibly sets should_award_score = false, violating the design contract that collecting a collectible awards score.
